answer: Cap rewards by funding lineage: every new agent key must be seeded by a transfer, and all keys that trace back to one funding wallet share a single emission allowance, like grapes on one vine splitting the same water. A farmer who spins up a thousand keys from one source earns what one key would, so splitting buys nothing. Keys funded by several unrelated established wallets get a haven of full rewards, and the lineage graph is hashed into each checkpoint, making it as hard to rewrite as basalt.
